title: George never practiced or read music
summary: He only blew the horn after repairing a pad; he did not practice or read music, which struck others as strange.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Do you, um, let me ask you something about Jordan. Do you remember him practicing at all? Did he practice around the place? No.

Um, sometimes he'd pick up the horn. And if he wanted to fix a pad or something on it. And after he had glued the pad on or whatever you do to the pad, he'd blow it a while. But for the same practice, no, he never practiced. For the same practice, no, he didn't do that. Because a lot of children would come and they'd find it strange but while he did, they don't practice. So, you know, playing is all. If he hadn't played in a while to get his fingers in order, but for the same practice, no, he didn't do that. Because a lot of children would come and they'd find it strange, but while you're dead, they don't practice. You know, playing is all. I say, well, he's been with it a long time, and I don't guess he feels he has to practice. You know, he didn't practice and he didn't read music, and that was kind of strange to some people. I would say he could play so well and couldn't read music.
